title: Restricted Hom equivalence and naturality fields
statement: Existence of a strict component of the restricted representing data

proof.text: For each stage, compose h.stageEquiv with the pinned projection adjunction relativeMVAdj.homEquiv. The supplied h.stageNatural and adjunction left naturality make the composite a natural isomorphism between the Yoneda functor of F.obj j and that of Rpi_j* Lpi_j* Q. Mathlib Yoneda.fullyFaithful.preimageIso produces the representing-object isomorphism. Repeat using h.limitEquiv and h.limitNatural for d.pt. This is the fully proved private helper representingIso.

Restrict the representing-object isomorphism to B. Apply schemeMVOpenRestrictionComparison to identify restriction of Rpi* Lpi* Q with R(pi|B)* of the restricted pullback. Apply mvPullbackOpenRestrictionIso to identify that coefficient with L(pi|B)* of Q restricted to B. Paste isPullback_morphismRestrict pi B vertically with the original pullback square; its isoPullback identifies the inverse-image open with the chosen pullback of B.ι followed by s. The inverse isomorphism preserves the projection to B. Apply relativeMVIsoOpenTransport to replace the restricted projection by pullback.fst (B.ι followed by s) t. This proves openPushPullIso for an arbitrary base-change map t, with no finiteness, QCoh, perfectness, or nonempty-open hypothesis.

Postcompose Hom into the restricted representing object with the constructed object isomorphism and compose with the inverse Hom equivalence of relativeMVAdj for the restricted projection. Associativity and homEquiv_naturality_left_symm prove testing-object naturality. This is restrictedHomEquiv, whose proof is complete.

Apply restrictedHomEquiv to each finite stage using h.stageEquiv and h.stageNatural, and to the apex using h.limitEquiv and h.limitNatural. Assemble stageEquiv, limitEquiv, stageNatural, and limitNatural into PerfectHomOpenRestrictedEquivFields. No transition maps, cocone maps, or QCoh fields are asserted by this item.
